lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
validator: 137,748 B in 113 modules on the contacts-oca page, of which its root index.js is 4,487 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
All 5 pages load the same 2 files: 1,775,876 B raw, 470,581 B gzip, 99.2 % of the smallest page (contacts-files-action, 1,790,706 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 690,716 B, @vuepic/vue-datepicker 140,829 B, @vue/runtime-core 65,235 B, axios 51,886 B, emoji-mart-vue-fast 48,103 B.
moment, 365,101 B on the contacts-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,477 B on the contacts-oca page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
